reason_for_multi_paragraph_paths: Before any model score, 2+1 found both support titles on only 31, 21 and 22 of 50 questions at 10, 30 and 60 paragraphs. 2+2 and 2+4 both improved this retrieval-only diagnostic. They use one additional retrieval round each.
timing: All 50 per size and route are independently measured from retrieval through answer parsing, with a fresh first call for each cascade. No cached answer is presented as live timing. Warmup is separate. Fixed-seed question blocks are at most eight; route and size order rotates between blocks.
quality: Offline official HotpotQA EM/F1, retrieved gold-title recall and both-title coverage, and cited gold-title recall. Paragraph citations are retained; sentence-level verification and NLI belong to the next phases.
oracle: For each fixed pair of first and expanded outputs, choose greater official F1, using the shared standalone top2 as A and choosing A on ties. Expand each path's own observed first output separately as a sensitivity check.
interpretation: Exploratory development results. Compare routes within each tested service. No gate or formal heldout evaluation.
